name: scraping-bot
description: TypeScript scraper for JSF-based jurisprudencia portal

scripts.scrape:fresh: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path -LiteralPath 'runs') { Remove-Item -LiteralPath 'runs' -Recurse -Force }; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath 'output') { Remove-Item -LiteralPath 'output' -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'runs' | Out-Null; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'output' | Out-Null; npm run scrape -- --config scraper.config.json"
